card.name: Patient risk groups like hepatitis B carriers or smokers
card.fires_on: Short words that sit in the middle of a risk-group phrase, such as 'B' in 'hepatitis B carriers', 'or' in 'current or past smokers', and 'V' in 'HBV-infected'. It also fires on the start of 'bupropion' after 'stop taking'.

modes.description: The letter B or V in 'hepatitis B' or 'HBV' just before 'carriers' or 'infected'.
